subject.title: Telegram voice message delayed ~15 minutes before agent dispatch, then run aborts

question: What should Telegram do when message.date is much older than dispatch time and the resulting voice-message turn aborts before any visible reply?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the threshold, restart/alert behavior, retry ownership, and direct-message fallback semantics affect real channel delivery and need maintainer intent before automation changes them.

options.title: Define a narrow latency and fallback policy
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify source-age logging, restart or alert conditions, and visible aborted-turn fallback behavior before queueing a fix.

options.title: Wait for a live repro first
options.body: Require a redacted live Telegram repro before choosing whether the fix belongs in polling, spooling, dispatch, or delivery accounting.

options.title: Treat adjacent items as enough
options.body: Rely on the open polling PR and voice-recovery issue, accepting that neither currently covers both the delayed dispatch and aborted/no-reply behavior.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow latency and fallback policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify source-age logging, restart or alert conditions, and visible aborted-turn fallback behavior before queueing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows recurring Telegram architecture and liveness work, and this product-sensitive channel policy needs an owner who can arbitrate between polling, dispatch, and delivery surfaces.
